raw.description:
Join BlueCloud: a global leader in cloud solutions with an exceptional focus on innovation, customer service, and employee engagement.

BlueCloud is a digital transformation company that specializes solely in implementing leading cloud technologies and solutions for our clients which include Fortune 500 and Fortune 200 level companies as well as start-ups. As a cloud-only and cloud-forward transformation company, we help organizations to enable and speed their journey to the cloud.

With a balanced view of strategy, people, process, and technology, we work with companies to understand their specific business needs to develop and implement practical business strategies and technology solutions.

Job Title: dbt Data Engineer

Summary:

We are looking for a talented and experienced dbt Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of data engineering principles and practices, as well as experience with dbt. The role will involve designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and data warehouses using dbt. The candidate will also be responsible for working with other data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to ensure that data is reliable, secure, and accessible.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and data warehouses using dbt
  • Work with other data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to ensure that data is reliable, secure, and accessible
  • Develop and deploy dbt models to automate data transformation and quality checks
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and data warehouses
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest dbt trends and technologies

Required Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering
  • 2+ years of experience with dbt
  • Strong understanding of data engineering principles and practices
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with SQL and other data modeling languages
  • Experience with version control systems, such as Git
  • Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Experience with data quality assurance and testing
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
Salary: DOE

raw.title: Director, Product Marketing - Analytics Partners
raw.excerpt: MinIO is the industry leader in high-performance object storage and the company behind the world’s fastest, most widely deployed object store, powering production infrastructure for more than half of the Fortune 500, including 9 of the 10 largest global automakers and all 10 of the largest U.
raw.description:
MinIO is the industry leader in high-performance object storage and the company behind the world’s fastest, most widely deployed object store, powering production infrastructure for more than half of the Fortune 500, including 9 of the 10 largest global automakers and all 10 of the largest U.S. banks. Our enterprise offering, AIStor, is engineered to handle the scale, speed, and pressure of modern AI and analytics, from terabytes to exabytes, all in a single namespace.

The Director, Product Marketing - Analytics Partners will play a pivotal role in shaping how MinIO is positioned within the Databricks ecosystem and the broader hybrid analytics and AI landscape. This role combines deep fluency in the modern data lakehouse, Delta Sharing, and open table formats with hands-on product marketing ownership of MinIO's most strategic data platform partnership. You will be responsible for understanding how AIStor Table Sharing extends Databricks to on-premises data, and translating that knowledge into differentiated messaging, joint content, and go to market strategies that resonate with data and AI leaders, platform engineers, and the Databricks field teams selling alongside us.

You will collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Alliances, Corporate Development, and counterparts at Databricks to craft and deliver the narratives that position AIStor as the data platform that unlocks on-premises data for Databricks. Every on-premises table connected through AIStor is a new workload running on Databricks compute, and this role owns the messaging that makes that commercial story land with Databricks account teams and end customers alike.

What You Will Do:

  • Databricks Partnership Narrative: Own the messaging and content that defines MinIO's role in the Databricks ecosystem across AIStor Table Sharing, Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog, Apache Iceberg™, and Delta Lake. Translate joint engineering work and architectural integration into co-marketing assets, reference architecture content, and customer-facing narratives that position Databricks as the hero with AIStor as the enabling data platform. Navigate across Product and Marketing across both companies to ensure that MinIO features and capabilities are tied to the newest capabilities and offerings from Databricks.
  • Executive Presence: Be the face of MinIO's marketing efforts for the Databricks partnership, representing the joint story at industry events, on webinars, in analyst briefings, and in executive conversations with Databricks and customer leadership.
  • Hybrid Analytics Positioning: Develop the technical and business positioning for AIStor Table Sharing as the bridge between on-premises data and Databricks cloud compute. Make the case for zero-copy, in-place data sharing as a required capability for enterprises with data sovereignty, time sensitivity, or scale constraints that keep critical datasets on-premises.
  • Cross-Audience Translation: Translate value across the seam between infrastructure and data teams, the two organizations that own the buying decision but don't always speak the same language. Build messaging that helps storage and infrastructure leaders bring a tangible win to their data team counterparts, and vice versa, and that gives Databricks AEs and MinIO reps a co-sell motion that covers both sides of the customer organization.
  • Partner Co-Marketing: Partner with Databricks marketing, product, and field teams to plan and execute joint launches, joint content, joint events, and co-branded technical assets. Align launch cadence and messaging with Databricks roadmap milestones and major moments like Databricks Data + AI Summit. Build durable co-marketing programs that drive pipeline for both companies.
  • Solutions Marketing for Vertical Use Cases: Build solutions content for the verticals where regulated or high-gravity on-premises data meets active Databricks footprint. Primary focus on financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, and federal and public sector. Expansion into telecommunications, retail, automotive, and energy and utilities as the partnership matures. Each vertical becomes a defensible, field-ready story anchored in real customer outcomes.
  • Field Enablement for Joint Selling: Build and deliver the enablement content (battlecards, talk tracks, customer presentations, technical briefs, one-pagers) that lets MinIO sellers and Databricks AEs, Solutions Architects, Partner Solutions Architects, and Field CTOs confidently co-sell into hybrid analytics opportunities. Articulate the joint commercial value for Databricks account teams: every on-premises table unlocked through AIStor is net-new Databricks compute consumption.
  • Product Launch Execution: Drive the GTM strategy and execution for AIStor releases that touch the Databricks ecosystem. Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Field, Sales including Channel Partners, and Communications to land launches that move pipeline and resonate across our technical champions and buyer personas.
  • BDR and Demand Generation Support: Partner with the BDR team to build outbound sequences, post-event follow-up programs, and inbound nurture tracks targeting Databricks-centric accounts. Equip the funnel with the right messaging at every stage.

Your Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in product marketing, with at least 3 years focused on data platforms, analytics, lakehouse architectures, or strategic partner marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience driving partner co-marketing programs with strategic technology partners such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud, or other major data and cloud platforms.
  • Strong technical acumen on lakehouse architecture, open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg™), data sharing protocols, and the modern data and AI stack. Fluent enough to engage credibly with Databricks product and field teams and with technical buyers at customer accounts.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, differentiated narratives for both economic buyers (CIO, CDO, CTO, CISO, VP of Data and Analytics) and technical champions (Director of Data Engineering, Principal Data Architect, Databricks Platform Owner, Lead Data Engineer).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience creating sales enablement content and customer-facing materials. Tight, prose-forward copy. No reliance on bullet-heavy formatting where prose works better.
  • Track record of executing high-stakes product launches with cross-functional coordination across Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and external partners.
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.
  • Direct experience working with or alongside Databricks, including familiarity with Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Mosaic AI, or the broader Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Apache Iceberg™, Delta Lake, and the open lakehouse ecosystem, including catalog technologies and table format interoperability.
  • Background that includes time in technical roles (engineering, solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or developer relations) or in data and analytics functions.
  • Familiarity with MinIO, S3-compatible storage, or high-performance object storage for AI and analytics workloads.
  • Experience marketing into regulated industries (financial services, federal, healthcare) where data sovereignty and on-premises data gravity shape buying decisions.
  • Experience marketing to North American enterprises required. Familiarity with EU and UK enterprise data sovereignty considerations a plus, with the ability to calibrate tone for understated, factual European market communication.

What We Offer:

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • 401K with 3% Contribution
  • Pre-IPO Stock Options
  • At least 12 Public Holidays
  • Flexible Time Off
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

raw.description:
About First Connect:

First Connect Insurance Services is a digital platform providing independent insurance agents with access to top US carriers and the optionality necessary to grow their businesses. Agents can work with over 130 carriers, selling various insurance policies, including home, auto, small business, and more. We’re on a mission to overhaul the technology agents have access to, putting consumer-grade software at their fingertips. We have partnerships with thousands of active agents with hundreds joining monthly and we plan to accelerate our growth.

Role Overview:

As an Account Manager I at First Connect, you will play a critical role in driving agency growth by converting new leads into active users of our digital insurance platform. Focused on onboarding independent insurance agencies, you’ll serve as the first point of contact for prospective agents who have shown interest through marketing efforts or lead generation channels. Your responsibilities will include outreach, vetting agency fit, guiding them through sign-up and contract execution, and supporting their integration onto the platform. It’s an ideal role for an insurance professional who thrives in a fast-paced, tech-enabled environment and is motivated by both individual performance and team impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Engage with interested leads who have interacted with marketing content or other lead generation channels.
  • Conduct high volume outreach and follow-up efforts (incoming and outbound calls, emails, SMS) with prospective agencies to present platform benefits and service offerings.
  • Vet agencies to assess fit for platform participation, including validating licensing, E&O, and lead sources.
  • Facilitate the sign-up and contract process between the agency and First Connect.
  • Support onboarding and integration of small to medium-sized agencies to the First Connect platform.
  • Help agencies gain access to over 130 carriers across personal and commercial insurance lines.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of insurance sales experience
  • Active insurance license
  • Proficiency with navigating multiple software platform
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working virtually or in a remote environment
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented

Benefits & Perks:
First Connect treats its team members with the same level of dedication and care as we do our customers, which is why we’re fortunate to provide our team with:

  • Multiple medical plans to choose from and 100% employer-covered dental; vision plans for our team members and their families.
  • We also offer a 401(k) retirement plan, short; long-term disability, employer-paid life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Work-From-Home Stipend – Employer-provided WFH equipment and an $85 monthly expense stipend to ensure you’re set up for success.
  • Equity - This position is eligible for equity compensation
  • Training and Career Growth - Training and internal career growth opportunities
  • Flexible Time Off - You know when and how you should recharge

This is a base + commission role. The base pay ranges from $65,000 to $70,000 annually, with target sales commissions totaling an additional $30,000 annually.

First Connect is an equal-opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.

Applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to an applicant’s disability or need for accommodation. Any First Connect applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the First Connect People Team to make the need for an accommodation known.

raw.excerpt: About Catch CreationCatch Creation is a global eCommerce company built for the digital age.
raw.description:
About Catch Creation

Catch Creation is a global eCommerce company built for the digital age. We create, grow, and manage online brands that inspire customers and deliver real value through exceptional products and experiences. Our team thrives in a fully remote environment, combining creativity, data-driven strategy, and innovation to build scalable eCommerce solutions that perform.

From concept to conversion, we specialize in developing brands that stand out in competitive markets—driven by a passion for design, storytelling, and customer satisfaction. Every product we launch reflects our commitment to quality, authenticity, and growth.

At Catch Creation, we believe great ideas can come from anywhere—and our remote-first culture allows talented people from around the world to collaborate, innovate, and bring those ideas to life.

Head of Retail Expansion

Location: Remote (US-based preferred) with travel required

Reports to: CEO

Type: Full-Time, Senior Leadership

About Muddy Mat

Muddy Mat is the market-leading pet-friendly home products brand, best known for our ultra-absorbent chenille door mats designed to trap mud, water, and dirt from pet paws and shoes. We sell across multiple categories including anti-mud mats, outdoor mats, dog beds, washable rugs, and accessories. With over 50,000 five-star reviews and a 9 figure a year brand, Muddy Mat has proven massive product-market fit as a direct-to-consumer brand selling through our own website, Amazon, Walmart.com, TikTok Shop, Chewy, and other digital channels.

Now we’re entering the next phase: taking Muddy Mat from a digital-first brand to a brand you can find on retail shelves worldwide. That’s where you come in.

The Role

The Head of Retail Expansion will own the strategy and execution of bringing Muddy Mat into physical retail and wholesale channels, both in the United States and internationally. This is not a store operations role. This is a senior business development and sales leadership position focused on getting Muddy Mat onto shelves at major retailers, building distributor relationships globally, and scaling a profitable retail channel from the ground up.

Core Responsibilities

Retail & Wholesale Expansion (US)

  • Identify, pitch, and close deals with major US retailers, including Target, Walmart (in-store), Costco, PetSmart, Chewy (physical), TJ Maxx, HomeGoods, Bed Bath & Beyond, and specialty pet retailers
  • Develop and execute the retail go-to-market strategy for each channel, including pricing, packaging, planogram positioning, and promotional planning
  • Negotiate terms, margins, co-op advertising, and shelf space agreements with category buyers
  • Own the retail P&L and be accountable for revenue targets and channel profitability

International Retail & Distribution

  • Build and manage relationships with international distributors to bring Muddy Mat into retail markets in the UK, EU, Canada, Australia, and other target regions
  • Evaluate and select distribution partners based on market coverage, retail relationships, logistics capability, and alignment with brand standards
  • Develop market entry strategies for each region, including pricing localization, regulatory compliance, and packaging requirements
  • Negotiate distributor agreements including exclusivity terms, minimum order commitments, margin structures, and performance benchmarks
  • Coordinate with internal teams on international inventory planning, forecasting, and supply chain logistics

Key Account Management & Sell-Through

  • Manage day-to-day wholesale account relationships with retail buyers at key chains
  • Monitor sell-through rates, manage reorder cycles, and optimize assortment by retailer
  • Drive in-store merchandising, brand presentation, and compliance across all retail touchpoints
  • Develop co-marketing programs with retail partners to accelerate sell-through velocity

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work with supply chain and operations to ensure inventory readiness for retail launches and reorders
  • Coordinate with marketing on retail-specific packaging, point-of-sale materials, and brand assets
  • Partner with finance on retail margin analysis, trade spend management, and channel profitability reporting
  • Collaborate with the e-commerce team to ensure retail strategy complements (not cannibalizes) DTC channels

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in retail sales, wholesale, or business development in consumer goods
  • Proven, demonstrable track record of taking a DTC or ecommerce-native brand into physical retail at national or big-box retailers (this is non-negotiable — we need someone who has done this before, not someone who wants to try)
  • Direct experience managing international distributors and launching products into retail markets outside the United States
  • Existing relationships with retail buyers at major chains in pet, home, housewares, or consumer goods categories
  • Deep understanding of retail economics: margin structures, trade spend, co-op programs, slotting fees, and promotional planning
  • Experience with retail-specific packaging, compliance, barcode/UPC requirements, and planogram standards
  • Strong negotiation skills with a track record of closing complex, high-value retail agreements
  • Ability to own a P&L and be accountable for a revenue target

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience specifically in the pet products, home goods, or housewares categories
  • Background working at a high-growth DTC brand that successfully expanded into retail (not the other way around — we need the DTC-to-retail playbook)
  • Familiarity with Amazon and other marketplace dynamics and how they interact with retail channel strategy
  • Experience working with or selling into UK, EU, Canadian, and Australian retail markets
  • Existing distributor network in international markets
  • Experience managing retail broker relationships (Walmart, Target)

Why Muddy Mat

  • Market leader with over 50,000 five-star reviews and massive consumer demand already proven online
  • $200M+ annual revenue run rate with strong unit economics and gross margins above 85%
  • You’re not building from zero — you’re taking a brand with proven product-market fit and expanding it into an entirely new channel
  • Direct access to the CEO and a lean, high-performance leadership team with the resources and ambition to execute at scale
  • Opportunity to build the retail division from the ground up and own it entirely
  • Compensation package includes competitive base, performance bonus, and equity participation

Compensation

Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonus tied to retail revenue targets. Equity participation available for the right candidate. Full benefits package.

raw.description:
Design, das gesehen wird. Und im Kopf bleibt.

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Marketing Visuals & Brand Design wirst du Teil eines schnell wachsenden Tech-Unternehmens und arbeitest an Aufmaster, der führenden App für digitale Kabeldokumentation.

Bei Aufmaster gestaltest du visuelle Inhalte für eine Marke, die echte Macher anspricht. Du arbeitest auf Basis unserer Aufmaster Brand Guidelines und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Marketing-Website, Präsentationen, Flyer und weitere visuelle Touchpoints konsistent, hochwertig und wiedererkennbar gestaltet sind.

Unsere einzigartige Lösung wird bereits in über 34 Ländern weltweit eingesetzt. Entsprechend wichtig ist eine visuelle Sprache, die international funktioniert und komplexe Inhalte verständlich transportiert. Deine Designs helfen dabei, Technologie, Nutzen und Marke klar auf den Punkt zu bringen – ohne unnötige Komplexität.

Als Werkstudent bist du bei uns nicht nur unterstützend tätig, sondern ein fester Teil des Teams. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und Sales zusammen, erhältst regelmäßig Feedback und entwickelst deine Skills im Bereich Brand Design und visuelle Kommunikation anhand realer Projekte kontinuierlich weiter.

So wächst nicht nur unsere Marke - sondern auch du, fachlich und persönlich.

Aufgaben

  • Gestaltung und Erstellung von visuellen Inhalten für unsere Marketing-Website
  • Überarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Präsentationen, Flyern und weiteren Marketingmaterialien
  • Umsetzung von Marketing-Assets auf Basis der Aufmaster Brand Guidelines und Sicherstellung eines konsistenten Markenauftritts
  • Visuelle Unterstützung von Marketing-, Sales- und Produktkommunikation
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing-Team bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung visueller Inhalte
  • Kreativer Support bei Kampagnen, Releases und neuen Marketinginitiativen
  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Design-Templates (z. B. für Präsentationen oder Marketingmaterialien)
  • Erstellung von Grafiken und Visuals für Social Media oder digitale Kampagnen
  • Erfahrung mit gängigen Design-Tools (z. B. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite)

Qualifikation

  • Eingeschriebener Student im Bereich Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign, Visual Communication, Marketing Design oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Erste praktische Erfahrung im Grafik-, Brand- oder Marketingdesign (z. B. durch Projekte, Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma und/oder gängigen Design-Tools (z. B. Adobe Creative Suite)
  • Gutes Gespür für visuelle Klarheit, Typografie, Layout und Markenwirkung
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Arbeitszeit

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This is a remote role and must be based in the Northeast US.
Travel: Up to 50% domestic
Job ID: 1650

The Role:

We are looking for an Experienced Senior Sales Executive who will be part of a cross-functional team whose mission is to lead IonQ commercial expansion into States and Academic Institutions within their target region. The product coverage covers all of IonQ’s portfolio including Quantum Computing, Networking, Sensing, Applications and Space. This is an individual contributor role, targeted at experienced sales leads with the ability and expertise in building a team as the business expands.

The GTM lead will be the ultimate owner of account relationships and GTM strategy in partnership with a Field Engineering lead who will bring the technology depth in support of all market development activities in the target region

Responsibilities:

  • Create and execute IonQ’s SLED sales strategy covering all aspects of IonQ portfolio (Compute Hardware / Software and AppDev, Networking, Sensing and Space).
  • Develop strategic relationships at senior levels of State and Academic institutions.

  • Develop a pipeline of sales opportunities for IonQ’s Quantum Computers.
  • Work with customers and prospects to identify and collaborate on new use cases in partnership with IonQ’s AppDev team.
  • Qualify the opportunities based on budget availability, skills, interest, executive commitment, and timing.
  • Create proposals aligned with the opportunity at stake taking into consideration State and local restrictions.
  • Negotiate agreements and close business deals.

  • Existing relationships with Academic and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Existing relationships with Academic and Government stakeholders in target Geo.
  • Minimum of 15-years experience in Hardware Infrastructure or AI/ML Technology Sales/Business Development with quota carrying responsibilities in public sector.
  • Experience in early market development for emerging Tech.

Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401K, unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. Forensic Electrical Engineer - Florida

At Haag, a Salas O’Brien company, we’ve been a trusted leader in forensic engineering and consulting since 1924, helping clients solve complex, high-stakes problems when it matters most. We’re known for technical excellence, integrity, and clear, defensible conclusions. We’re equally committed to building a career environment where talented engineers can do their best work, grow their expertise, and make a real impact.

In June2024, Haag merged with Salas O’Brien, expanding what’s possible for our team. Haag remains focused on forensic engineering, and we now offer the added strength of a broader, employee-owned organization. This brings deeper technical resources, expanded collaboration, and more opportunities to build your career across a wide range of disciplines and industries.

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We are engineered for impact, and we bring that same commitment to our people as we do to our projects. We live our values every day: Inspire, Achieve, and Connect, as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for energy, manufacturing and industrial process, data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more. Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to deliver outstanding client outcomes and build long-term careers.

Job Summary: We’re seeking a Forensic Electrical Engineer to join our team in Florida. In this remote/home office role, you will investigate and evaluate the root cause and extent of failures and damage involving electrical systems, components, and devices across residential, commercial, and industrial settings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Forensic Investigations: Conduct field inspections to determine the origin, cause, and extent of electrical failures, including fires, explosions, and system malfunctions.
  • Analysis & Reporting: Develop clear, well-supported conclusions and produce comprehensive technical reports and documentation.
  • Client Communication: Provide timely, professional updates to clients, attorneys, insurers, and internal stakeholders; manage expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Collaboration & Independence: Work independently from a home office while leveraging internal experts and resources; build long-term relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners.
  • Project Ownership: Drive investigations through completion, ensuring high-quality deliverables that meet client expectations and industry standards.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute ideas that strengthen processes, tools, and customer outcomes; help others navigate change and adopt improvements.

Qualifications and Experience

Experience:

  • 5–10 years of experience working with or designing electrical systems.
  • Forensic engineering experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience investigating electrical failures, fires, or explosions.
  • Expert witness experience, including depositions and trial testimony, preferred.
  • Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce clear, defensible reports is critical.
  • Strong verbal communication and client service skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Proficiency with technical tools (computers, cameras, and engineering software).
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Licensure & Certifications:

  • Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in Florida is required, or eligible by reciprocity.

About the role:
The Solution Architect – Workday Integration & Security is responsible for the design, delivery, and governance of secure, scalable Workday integrations and security frameworks. This role serves as the technical authority across integration architecture and Workday security, ensuring solutions are compliant, audit-ready, and aligned with enterprise standards.

The role partners closely with HR, IT, InfoSec, and third-party vendors to ensure that all integrations are secure-by-design, properly documented, and operationally sustainable.

In this role, a typical day will look like: 

Architecture & Design

  • Define and own end-to-end architecture for Workday integrations and security design

  • Establish secure integration patterns, including authentication, encryption, and data transfer mechanisms

  • Design and govern Workday security models (ISUs, ISSGs, domain security, segmented security)

  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards

Solution Delivery & Execution

  • Lead full lifecycle delivery of integrations from requirements through deployment

  • Translate business and compliance requirements into scalable technical designs

  • Oversee development using Workday tools (Studio, EIB, APIs, XSLT)

  • Ensure adherence to integration development and security standards

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure all solutions meet internal security policies and audit requirements (e.g., SOX, data protection standards)

  • Validate secure configuration of integrations (SFTP, APIs, certificates, encryption)

  • Own integration-related audit readiness, documentation, and control evidence

  • Partner with InfoSec and audit teams to address compliance gaps

Governance & Standards

  • Establish and enforce integration and security standards, naming conventions, and documentation practices

  • Maintain integration inventory, architecture diagrams, and data flow documentation

  • Perform impact analysis for Workday releases and security changes

  • Drive consistency across global teams and vendors

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as technical advisor to HR, IT, and Security stakeholders

  • Partner with vendors (e.g., Deloitte, PwC) to ensure solution quality and compliance

  • Lead architecture reviews, design sessions, and security validations

Production Support & Incident Management

  • Serve as escalation point for complex integration and security issues

  • Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution for incidents

  • Ensure operational stability and continuous improvement of integrations

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Define integration and security testing strategies (unit, SIT, UAT, security validation)

  • Ensure validation of data accuracy, integrity, and access controls

  • Oversee defect management and resolution processes

The essential requirements of the job include: 

  • 7-10years of experience in enterprise applications (Workday preferred)

  • Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors

  • REST/SOAP APIs, XSLT

  • Workday Extend, Orchestrate

  • Experience with:

  • Workday HCM modules such as Recruiting, Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Learning, or Payroll

  • Supporting global or multi-country HCM integrations.

  • Workday implementation, post-production optimization, or tenant transformation programs.

  • Deep understanding of:

  • Workday security framework (domains, roles, ISUs/ISSGs)

  • Secure integration design (encryption, SFTP, certificates)

  • Experience supporting audits and regulatory compliance initiatives

  • Proven experience leading complex technical solutions end-to-end

raw.excerpt: 🚀 About UsWe’re Bolt. new by StackBlitz! We’re the team that brought you WebContainers, the first-of-its-kind technology that made it possible to run Node.
raw.description:
🚀 About Us

We’re Bolt.new by StackBlitz!

We’re the team that brought you WebContainers, the first-of-its-kind technology that made it possible to run Node.js right inside your browser. That breakthrough kicked off our journey in 2019, and it’s what powers the blazing-fast online IDE used by over 1 million developers every month.

But we didn’t stop there. We doubled down on everything we learned and built Bolt.new — the fastest way to go from idea to production without writing traditional code. It’s a next-gen, AI-powered app builder that helps you create, edit, and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps instantly, right in your browser. No installs. No setup. Just smart automation and instant dev environments that let you move at the speed of thought.

We’re a fully remote team, globally distributed, deeply collaborative, and seriously passionate about building the future of software development.

This is your chance to join a small team with a big vision. If you love shipping fast, solving real problems, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, we’d love to meet you.

✨ About This Opportunity

Join us on the forefront of AI-powered development as we revolutionize how software gets built. As a Senior Applied Engineer, you will be the driving force behind our AI agents that transform natural language into production ready applications. You will work with state-of-the art LLMs, pioneering new ways to make AI understand, reason about, and generate complex full-stack applications. This isn’t just about integrating APIs, instead it’s about pushing the boundaries of what AI can do to empower our users to build stunning apps. As part of this role, you will work in an interesting problem space and tackle challenges like maintaining context across large codebases, orchestrating multi-step workflows that feel intuitive to users, and making sure our AI agents can handle everything from simple UI changes to complex architectural decisions. Your work will directly impact how millions of users bring their ideas to life.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-assisted development in a fully remote, globally distributed team that ships fast and thinks big. If you are passionate about making AI more capable, reliable, and accessible to builders everywhere, this role offers the perfect opportunity to innovate and see your work deployed at scale.

🛠️ How You'll Contribute

  • Develop AI Agents: Design and implement AI agent features and extend existing agents with new capabilities. This includes managing the agent’s context (using techniques like sub-agents, retrieval based context management, sliding context windows, etc.) so it can handle long conversations or large knowledge and code bases efficiently.
  • Integrate Multiple LLM Providers: Leverage models from providers such as OpenAI (GPT series), Anthropic (Claude), and Google (Gemini). Quantitatively evaluate and choose the best model for a given task, and incorporate new model features or improvements (often by beta-testing new releases and assessing their strengths).
  • Tool Use and Workflow Orchestration: Enable the AI agent to call external tools and APIs safely and effectively. Implement structured approaches to allow the agent to perform actions like web searches, database queries, fetch additional information, or other domain-specific operations. Utilize frameworks such as Vercel’s AI SDK, LangGraph and others for building multi-step AI workflows.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with your immediate team and adjacent teams to deliver AI-powered features. Collaborate effectively with peer engineers and product managers to ensure AI-driven features are production-ready, efficient, maintainable, and well-monitored in deployment. Share knowledge and help lift up mid-level and junior engineers on the team.
  • Data Collection and Analysis: Collect and curate datasets from agent responses and multi-turn conversations to understand agent behavior. Analyze conversation patterns, failure modes, and success signals to derive actionable insights that drive improvements to agent performance and user experience.
  • Continuous Improvement and Evaluation: Stay up-to-date with the latest research in NLP and LLMs, and experiment with novel techniques (e.g. new prompting strategies, context handling methods, model fine-tuning opportunities). Continuously evaluate the AI system’s performance using systematic tests and user feedback, and iterate on prompts, agents and workflows to improve output quality and reliability (for example, by developing automated LLM evaluation benchmarks).

💡 Qualifications

  • TypeScript: Familiarity with TypeScript is important. Our entire stack is built on it. Willingness to work in TS daily is key.
  • LLM Experience: Hands-on experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and understanding their capabilities and limitations. Proven experience building applications or systems powered by LLMs.
  • Prompt Engineering: Deep understanding of prompt engineering best practices to guide LLM behavior. Able to craft, refine, and optimize prompts for different tasks and models.
  • Software Engineering Skills: Solid software engineering fundamentals with experience in building production-ready systems.
  • Autonomous Execution: Ability to deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight. Comfortable owning tasks end-to-end, managing complexity, and driving projects to completion within your functional area.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to debug complex AI behaviors and bring clarity to ambiguous tasks.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable collecting, curating, and analyzing data to inform decisions. Able to build datasets, identify patterns in agent behavior, and translate findings into actionable improvements.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills are required, as this role involves frequent collaboration with team members, stakeholders, and customers where English is the primary working language.

🎯 Bonus Points

  • DSPy Framework: Familiarity with DSPy (Declarative Self-improving Python) for building modular AI systems and optimizing prompts programmatically.
  • Machine Learning Background: Understanding of ML fundamentals and experience with model evaluation metrics.
  • Open Source Contributions: Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source AI/ML projects.
  • Research Background: Experience reading and implementing techniques from AI/ML research papers.

📌 A Few Notes

  • You do not need a college degree to apply

  • You do not need to be located in the U.S. — we’re remote-friendly

  • You do not need to meet every qualification listed above

Open-minded - we’re always evolving and keep an open mind as to new ways of doing things, new solutions and new processes that can help us.

Optimistic - The glass is always half full :) as a growing tech startup we’re always faced with new challenges, we overcome them because we see them as opportunities.

Leaders - We look for drivers, people who like to set the pace of the organization, who don’t simply go with the flow, you’re setting a fast impact pace and holding others to it. We look for speed, impact, and setting the industry benchmark.

We creatively integrate new elements in innovative combinations, fueled by our optimism to drive success. Our open-mindedness allows us to embrace new ideas and approaches, empowering us to lead our industry through bold initiatives. That’s the attitude we bring to work with us every day, and it’s what we expect from everyone who works here.

That’s just part of the values that drive us to greatness. We also believe in this trio of truths that inform every decision we make and everything we do:

  • Sleeves Up: At the COOL company, we provide you with the autonomy and creativity needed to own your role. We encourage iteration where necessary so that you can drive massive impact.
  • 100% Viewability: the COOL company is passionate about open feedback at all levels of the company. This allows us to fail fast, create in real-time, and build an open company culture.
  • Be Defiantly Great: We're defiant, and that's in our blood. Challenging the status quo is a central part of who we are. We're capable of much more than what others deem impossible.

About the Role

The Technical Product Manager will serve as the bridge between our business teams, customers, and engineering organization. Reporting directly to the CTO, this role is responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and driving resolution of product issues, workflow gaps, usability improvements, and feature requests across COOLAI and related platforms.

The ideal candidate is highly technical, comfortable working in ambiguity, able to independently investigate issues, and capable of coordinating across Engineering, Data Science, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams.

Challenges and Opportunities

As COOLAI continues to scale, feedback from clients, sales teams, and internal stakeholders is increasing rapidly. This role will help create structure around product feedback, improve execution efficiency, and allow technical leadership to focus on strategic initiatives and platform innovation.

This position offers significant growth opportunities and direct exposure to company leadership, AI-driven advertising technology, and next-generation marketing automation products.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Own intake and triage process for product feedback and issues
  • Investigate reported problems and reproduce issues independently
  • Distinguish between bugs, usability concerns, feature requests, and training gaps
  • Prioritize issues based on customer impact, revenue impact, and strategic importance
  • Write clear product requirements and engineering tickets
  • Coordinate implementation with engineering and data science teams
  • Communicate status and timelines to stakeholders
  • Monitor product quality and identify recurring pain points
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to gather user insights
  • Drive continuous improvement of internal workflows and processes
  • Help define product roadmap priorities based on customer feedback and business objectives
  • Track product delivery metrics and ensure accountability across teams

Qualifications

  • 3–7 years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Solutions Engineering, or similar role
  • Experience working closely with software engineering teams
  • Strong understanding of SaaS products and web applications
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently
  • Experience writing detailed product requirements and user stories
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving startup environments
  • Experience with AI, AdTech, MarTech, DSPs, SSPs, or digital advertising is highly preferred

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical thinking
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • High ownership mentality
  • Ability to work in ambiguity
  • Strong prioritization skills
  • Excellent written communication
  • Customer-centric mindset
  • Technical curiosity
  • Cross-functional leadership
  • Ability to influence without authority

Cultural Competencies

  • Must be able to work primarily between the hours of 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM ET
  • Must have a player/coach mentality, willing to both execute and lead
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects concurrently and set and meet deadlines
  • Skilled at receiving and providing direct feedback
  • Collaborative mindset and great teamwork skills
  • Entrepreneurial & adaptable; great learning skills
  • Curious, research-minded, data-informed
  • Able to search for possible solutions and apply them
  • Creative confidence

raw.excerpt: About Gevme Gevme is a fast-growing Singapore-based company providing a virtual and hybrid event platform that helps event professionals build, operate, and monetise unique event experiences.
raw.description:
About Gevme
Gevme is a fast-growing Singapore-based company providing a virtual and hybrid event platform that helps event professionals build, operate, and monetise unique event experiences.
Our platform has powered hundreds of thousands of events around the world for leading brands and organisations, including Facebook, Netflix, Starbucks, the Singapore Government, Forbes, and MasterCard.
We are a product company with a strong engineering and family culture, constantly exploring new ways to empower event professionals through technology. As we grow, we are on a mission to build the next generation of event technology thought leaders.
The Role
We are looking for an SEO & AEO Specialist with 3–6 years of experience to strengthen Gevme’s organic search visibility, content performance, and answer-engine presence. In this role, you will create, optimise, and publish high-quality content that helps Gevme rank better on search engines, appear in answer based results, improve visibility across AI-powered search experiences, and attract the right B2B SaaS and event technology audiences. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong writing skills, SEO thinking, analytical ability, and independent research.
What You’ll Do
  • Own content writing, optimisation, and publishing across Gevme’s digital channels, including blogs, website pages, landing pages, emails, ads, and social media.
  • Create original, research-driven, and high-value content that supports Gevme’s brand voice, business goals, and customer needs.
  • Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, and competitor content analysis to identify ranking and visibility opportunities.
  • Optimise content for SEO, including titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, image alt text, readability, and content structure.
  • Optimise content for AEO by creating clear answers, FAQs, structured content sections, featured snippet-friendly formats, and conversational search-ready content.
  • Improve Gevme’s visibility across Google search, AI search platforms, featured snippets, People Also Ask results, and answer-based discovery channels.
  • Build and manage content calendars to ensure consistent publishing across platforms.
  • Proofread, edit, and improve content before publishing to ensure clarity, accuracy, quality, and brand alignment.
  • Collaborate with marketing, design, product, and development teams to deliver content and SEO initiatives on time.
  • Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, CTR, conversions, and content performance.
  • Prepare regular SEO, AEO, and content performance reports with insights, recommendations, and action plans.
  • Stay updated with SEO trends, AI search trends, AEO practices, B2B SaaS marketing, and event technology industry developments.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For
  • 3–6 years of experience in content marketing, SEO content writing, SEO strategy, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS content marketing.
  • Experience creating content for blogs, websites, landing pages, emails, ads, social media, and other digital platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of SEO, including keyword research, on-page SEO, search intent, internal linking, content optimisation, and competitor analysis.
  • Understanding of AEO, featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search, AI search, and answer-based content formats.
  • Ability to create original, insightful, and research-backed content that is not generic or overly dependent on AI tools.
  • Ability to write for both humans and search engines while maintaining clarity, quality, and brand voice.
  • Experience analysing content performance and making data-backed recommendations.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO/content tools.
  • Excellent proofreading, editing, communication, and storytelling skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple content projects independently.
Good to Have
  • Experience in the event technology industry.
  • Experience writing for B2B SaaS, event management, virtual events, hybrid events, marketing technology, or enterprise software audiences.
  • Knowledge of technical SEO basics such as crawlability, indexing, schema markup, page speed, and Core Web Vitals.
  • Experience with CMS platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot, or similar platforms.
  • Experience creating thought leadership content, case studies, whitepapers, reports, or long-form guides.


Benefits

What We Offer
  • Opportunity to work with a fast-growing Singapore-based event technology product company.
  • Ownership of content, SEO, and AEO-focused visibility projects.
  • Exposure to global B2B SaaS audiences and event technology trends.
  • Freedom to experiment with content formats, topics, channels, and search-led growth ideas.
  • A collaborative culture with marketing, product, engineering, and design teams.
  • A role where creativity, research, execution, and measurable impact are valued.
Why Gevme
At Gevme, you will work on a product that powers meaningful event experiences for organizations around the world. Our platform has supported events for some of the world’s most recognised brands and institutions, and we continue to innovate in the event technology space. This role gives you the opportunity to shape how Gevme is discovered across search engines, AI-powered platforms, and digital channels. You will not just write content; you will help build Gevme’s authority, visibility, and thought leadership in the global event technology industry. If you enjoy creating high-quality content, improving search performance, understanding audience intent, and turning content into measurable business growth, this role gives you the space to do meaningful work with real impact.

Company

DataBP is a fast-growing technology company that provides a SaaS platform and managed services to help the world’s leading financial institutions—exchanges, index providers, and data vendors—manage their market data licensing, reporting, billing, compliance, and commercial operations. Clients including CME Group, London Stock Exchange Group, Deutsche Börse, TMX, ASX, and SGX rely on our solutions to run efficient and scalable commercial data businesses.

Summary

We are seeking an Implementation Specialist to support client onboarding and enhancement projects. The Implementation Specialist works closely with Solution Architects and the Client Delivery team to ensure the platform is configured or customized to meet the needs of clients.

Clients include global securities exchanges, trading platforms, index providers, interdealer brokers and market data vendors. Candidate should have deep technology experience, excellent business analysis, planning and communication skills. Understanding of financial markets and market data are a major plus.

At DataBP, we value self-motivated and independent workers. Our team members work remotely around the world, and we are looking for people in all regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with clients to understand their business objectives
  • Advise clients on best practices regarding data licensing and compliance
  • Connect client business goals and requirements with DataBP platform capabilities
  • Design and configure custom client workflows using DataBP’s low-code workflow studio to suit the needs of the client
  • Translate business goals into technical requirements for development where required
  • Perform user acceptance testing
  • Assist in planning and prioritizing configuration and development efforts

Profile and Skills

  • Candidate must already be based in the Netherlands or another EU country.
  • A college degree in science (under graduate/bachelor’s degree or MBA preferred)
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in the financial markets
  • Technical fluency with javascript, SQL, python, etc
  • Experience with data management systems, market data products and services
  • Strong organizational and communication skills
  • Assertive and comfortable conducting client-facing meetings

Why Join Us?

At DataBP, you’ll be part of a team working with the world’s largest financial institutions to shape the future of how capital markets manage data assets. We are mission-driven, collaborative, and growing fast with clients that are transforming the global financial data ecosystem.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salary: Commensurate

raw.description:
Job Description:

The Role:  

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high-intensity, high-visibility execution role involving the creation of net-new data-driven, AI- and ML-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.

The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.

This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role: 

Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

  • Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect & adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas
  • Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement
  • Leading end-to-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform-specific workflows
  • Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor
  • Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization
  • Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream
  • Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
  • Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year-on-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures

What You Bring

  • 5-8 years of project management experience
  • Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard
  • A self-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told
  • Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal
  • Experience in technology-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution
  • Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities to improve team productivity and decision-making
  • Strong RAID discipline, schedule management, budget oversight, and the instinct to track details without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams concurrently in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus
  • North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.

This position has a starting salary range of $75,000 – $90,000 USD / 75,000 – 99,000 CAD per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Company Mission

Our mission in the market we serve is clear. To power every auto-related decision through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and seamless workflows that connect insight to action.

Our Values

We POWER Our Customer's Success

We are Innovative, Collaborative and Grounded in Data

We Make Things Easy

We Get It Done

We Start with Trust & Prove it Everyday

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

Should you require accommodations during the recruitment and selection process, please reach out to tarecruitment@jdpa.com.

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About Bluefin Payment Systems LLC

At Bluefin, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment where innovation and leadership are at the forefront of everything we do. Join us in revolutionizing data security within the integrated payments industry, as we protect over 35,000 companies across 59 countries with our cutting-edge encryption and tokenization technologies. Our collaborative culture empowers you to take initiative and make impactful contributions, while our commitment to professional growth ensures you have the tools and opportunities to excel. Embrace the challenge of working in a vibrant atmosphere that values agility and leadership, and be part of our mission to create secure, frictionless experiences for businesses and their customers. If you’re ready to drive change and make a difference, we invite you to embark on this exciting journey with us!

About the role

We are seeking a Marketing Operations & Demand Generation Manager to build and scale the operational engine that powers our demand generation efforts. This is a high-impact, hands-on role responsible for executing campaigns, managing marketing systems, and converting marketing engagement into qualified pipeline. You will play a critical role in enabling SDR success by ensuring leads are delivered, prioritized, and enriched with the right data and insights to drive effective follow-up. Working cross-functionally with marketing, SDRs, sales, and partnerships, this role ensures campaigns are executed flawlessly, leads are routed intelligently, and performance is tracked with precision to drive measurable revenue impact. This role reports to the SVP, Marketing.

What you'll do

Marketing Automation & Campaign Execution

  • Own end-to-end execution of marketing campaigns within Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (formerly Pardot), including email builds, deployment, and QA
  • Set up campaign structures, tracking, and reporting to ensure accurate performance measurement
  • Manage audience segmentation, including list creation and dynamic segmentation strategies
  • Maintain and optimize lead scoring and grading models in alignment with SDR and sales priorities
  • Troubleshoot and resolve campaign or system issues to ensure smooth execution

Demand Generation Campaign Support

  • Support the execution of multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and Google Ads
  • Coordinate campaign timelines, assets, and stakeholders across marketing, SDRs, sales, and partnerships
  • Assist with landing page setup and campaign infrastructure
  • Ensure campaigns launch on time and are fully tracked from engagement through pipeline

Lead Management & SDR Enablement

  • Own the flow of leads from demand generation campaigns to SDRs and commercial AEs, ensuring timely, accurate, and prioritized follow-up
  • Monitor lead engagement and identify high-intent signals to guide follow-up
  • Ensure SDRs have full visibility into lead activity, campaign engagement, and context for outreach
  • Build and optimize feedback loops with SDRs to improve lead quality, targeting, and conversion

SDR Alignment & Pipeline Development

  • Partner directly with SDRs and commercial AEs to convert marketing-generated demand into qualified pipeline
  • Align on lead prioritization, follow-up strategy, and campaign-driven outreach
  • Incorporate SDR feedback on lead quality, messaging, and campaign performance
  • Optimize segmentation, targeting, and lead flow to improve conversion from lead to opportunity
  • Support SDR success by ensuring marketing programs generate actionable, high-quality pipeline

Performance Tracking & Reporting

  • Consolidate and analyze data across platforms including Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Salesforce, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and website analytics
  • Deliver regular reporting and actionable insights to marketing and sales leadership
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of marketing and pipeline data

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions:

  • 4–7+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation, or campaign execution
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (required) and Salesforce (required)
  • Strong understanding of B2B demand generation funnels and lead lifecycle management
  • Experience supporting SDR teams and aligning marketing efforts to pipeline generation
  • Proven ability to translate marketing engagement into measurable revenue outcomes
  • High attention to detail with a strong QA and process-oriented mindset
  • Analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and generate insights
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with SDR and sales teams
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or cybersecurity preferred

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Rayn, we don’t just work—we innovate, collaborate, and create solutions that leave a lasting impact. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will be the technical face of our organization at the client site, bridging the gap between our platform capabilities and the complex, real-world problems our customers face. You will lead technical discovery sessions, architect and deliver compelling pre-sales demonstrations, and serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and can translate technical depth into clear business value.

What you will bring to Rayn as an IT Support & Operations Engineer

  • Provide remote IT support to end users across multiple managed clients.
  • Troubleshoot user issues related to laptops, desktops, accounts, permissions, email, collaboration tools, audio/video setup, connectivity, and general IT operations.
  • Support both Microsoft and Google workplace environments, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Teams, Slack, Outlook, Gmail, SharePoint, OneDrive, and related tools.
  • Support both Mac and Windows devices, including basic device troubleshooting, user setup, configuration, and escalation where required.
  • Handle service desk tickets received through email, phone, and ITSM platforms with timely updates, clear documentation, and strong ownership.
  • Support joiner, mover, and leaver processes, including account creation, access changes, device readiness, and offboarding activities.
  • Assist with endpoint security, email security, backup checks, and basic cybersecurity support activities.
  • Use ITSM and documentation platforms to manage tickets, follow standard operating procedures, and maintain accurate support records.
  • Work closely with the client’s internal IT team to escalate complex issues, share updates, and ensure continuity of support.
  • Provide proactive, human-centric support by engaging users clearly and professionally, including direct calls where needed to resolve issues quickly.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality, professional conduct, and high ethical standards while supporting international clients.
  • Follow security and compliance requirements aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2 expectations, and client-specific information security protocols.
  • Contribute to knowledge transfer, documentation, process improvement, and ongoing upskilling within the support team.
  • Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve support quality, troubleshooting speed, ticket documentation, knowledge search, and service desk productivity.
  • Manage the IT budget, including forecasting and tracking expenses and ensuring that all IT projects and initiatives are completed on time and within budget.

Who We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT support, service desk, managed services, technical support, or a similar client-facing IT role.
  • Experience working in an MSP or multi-client support environment will be strongly preferred.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace administration and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on familiarity with both Windows and Mac operating systems.
  • Experience supporting collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, and Google Meet.
  • Understanding of basic networking, identity and access management, endpoint support, email configuration, permissions, and device troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as Halo, Autotask, ServiceNow, Freshservice, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with remote monitoring and management tools such as Ninja, Datto, or similar platforms will be an advantage.
  • Understanding of IT documentation and knowledge base tools such as IT Glue or similar platforms will be preferred.
  • Basic awareness of cybersecurity practices, endpoint protection, email security, data backup, MFA, access control, and secure remote support.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and AI-enabled service desk workflows, including ticket summarization, knowledge retrieval, automation, and user support assistance.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical issues in a clear, calm, and user-friendly manner.
  • Strong ownership, reliability, ethical judgment, and respect for confidentiality.
  • Comfortable working night shifts, weekend coverage, or extended support hours based on client requirements.
  • Ability to work independently while staying aligned with client processes, escalation paths, and service standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL-based service management practices.
  • Microsoft, Google, CompTIA, Apple, or cybersecurity-related certifications.
  • Prior experience supporting UK, European, or international clients.
  • Experience working in secure environments with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar compliance expectations.
  • Experience supporting fast-growth SaaS, DTC, financial services, or sustainability-focused businesses.
