raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About Swell:

Swell is on a mission to improve mental health support for military families. We envision a world of healthier, happier, kinder, and more mentally resilient people - and we’re making this possible through our full-circle mental health platform.

Last year we launched ourtelehealth therapy app, intended to help military members and spouses access evidence-based mental health therapy whenever they need it, covered by Tricare. Our platform combines traditional 1:1 video therapy sessions with a mobile application designed to enhance skill adoption outside of the session, and reduce the overall time-to-benefit in therapy. Overtime we’ll also be building out a self-guided portion of our platform focused on Interventional & Preventative mental healthcare for individuals and couples.

We’re a small startup created by a group of therapists, social workers, military spouses, and former service members. We’re passionate about improving access and outcomes for the military community and are looking for therapists (full or part-time) to join our team. If you’re excited about our mission and eager to support this community, then we want to talk to you!

What you’ll do here:

  • Provide evidence-based therapy via 55-minute live video sessions to adult clients.
  • Manage a consistent weekly caseload of clients (you choose how many sessions work for your lifestyle)
  • Establish and track goals in partnership with each of your clients, monitoring outcomes over time.
  • Assign & review in-app homework (video modules, daily journaling, check-ins, etc) tailored for each client.
  • Maintain progress notes and participate in quality reviews

About you:

  • You have empathy in spades
  • You’re a fully licensed therapist in the state of TN or KY (LMFT - Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, LCSW - Licensed Clinical Social Worker , or LPC-MHSP - Licensed Professional Counselor-Mental Health Services Provider)
  • You have experience treating individuals with relationship issues, trauma, PTSD, Postpartum Depression, Generalized Anxiety Disorder, and Depressive disorders
  • You work with evidence-based care modalities like CBT, DBT, EMDR, IFS, etc
  • Your practice is oriented around measurable change in clients' lives and usually involves SMART goals and skill building
  • You believe in challenging yourself and your clients, leaning into the discomfort that accompanies growth
Compensation & Perks:
  • $50/hour plus an additional $1/hour bonus for every year of post-license experience (this continues to go up as we negotiate up rates with insurers)
  • Stipend for CEU's: After your first 6 months at Swell, you'll receive a $100 stipend that can be used toward CEU's or licensing reimbursement. After 1 year at Swell, you'll receive another $125 stipend every 6 months for licensing and continuing education.
  • Free clinical consultations
  • Free marketing & billing
  • Free EHR access
  • Free secure client email Flexible schedule: you're in control of your schedule and appointment times and can commit to as many or few clients as you want beyond the 5-session weekly minimum.
  • Remote culture that supports you working from anywhere with an internet connection. A supportive team to connect and consult with. Minimal paperwork :)

Requirements:

  • Must already be licensed by a State Board to provide unsupervised mental health therapy (e.g., LPC-MHSP, LCSW, LMFT) in Tennessee or Kentucky.
  • Must have recent experience providing clinical therapy in an outpatient setting.
  • Must have access to a reliable internet connection that can support clear video calls.
  • Must have a dedicated therapy space that is quiet and private so you can work remotely and provide confidential therapy without distractions.
  • Must be able to maintain a consistent schedule to support reliable recurring sessions with clients.
Bonus Points:
  • Currently or previously credentialed with TRICARE
  • Bilingual in English/Spanish (we pay $1 more per session where the client requests a spanish-speaking therapist)
  • Have evening availability
  • Licensed in both KY & TN
Other info:
We’re looking for several therapists and are open to folks who are fully licensed with the state of Tennessee and/or Kentucky.

We prefer our therapists to have foundational training in at least one evidence-based therapy modality and trauma-informed care knowledge prior to starting at Swell. We’re happy to support you in further developing these skills through ongoing training, supervision, and consultation.

Individuals of all colors, backgrounds, religions (or lack thereof), sexual orientations, and gender identities who are passionate about helping clients bring about meaningful, measurable change in their lives are encouraged to apply.

Note: This is a contractor (non W2) position. Moonlighting with a private practice other group is permitted by Swell Health for contractors, but you'll have to sign a non-recruiting agreement for Swell clients.

Snyk is the leader in secure AI software development, helping millions of developers develop fast and stay secure as AI transforms how software is built. Our AI-native Developer Security Platform integrates seamlessly into development and security workflows, making it easy to find, fix, and prevent vulnerabilities — from code and dependencies to containers and cloud.

Our mission is to empower every developer to innovate securely in the AI era — boosting productivity while reducing business risk. We’re not your average security company - we build Snyk on One Team, Care Deeply, Customer Centric, and Forward Thinking.

It’s how we stay driven, supportive, and always one step ahead as AI reshapes our world.

Distributed Systems Engineer — Git & Source Control Infrastructure

The Mission

At Snyk, we manage the lifecycle of all monitored repositories. Our group builds the foundational services that provide standardized, secure access to our customers’ source code repositories.

We solve the challenge of acquiring and preparing hundreds of millions of files for Snyk’s analysis engines at scale. We also own the Ingress (webhooks) of SCM events and the Egress that acts as the path for requests out to cloud and on-prem SCMs.

The Tech

We write our services in Go (with an eye on Rust for performance-critical needs). We run on K8s and focus on high availability and system-wide abstraction.

What We Look For

Experience and interest inDistributed Systems Design and Cloud Infrastructure and a passion for building high-leverage foundational services.

The ability to communicate complex ideas through written clarity. We use shared 1-pagers, design documents and delivery plans to refine ideas and align before coding

High autonomy and long-term ownership. As an engineer in the team, you will own a problem and be entrusted to design, deliver and support the solution.



#

We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’ve created and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway!

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

  • Country-specific life insurance, disability benefits, and retirement/pension programs, plus mobile phone and education allowances

  • Anlagenbuchhaltung
